Name: (CP) Full beard for Philip - RSV
Author: 0krisa
Description:
This mod was originally made for personal use because I have a weakness for full beards, and now you can have it too. It is designed to work with Rafseazz's seasonal portraits mod, but you don't need that mod to use this one. The mod puts the beard on top of other portraits, so it does not edit the existing one. It also adds a full beard to the wedding reception photo.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] is obviously needed, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18202]Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside[/url] is optinonal.
